### Findings
The analysis evaluates item-level counts from `order_items` grouped by brand from `products` [q1]. Scope is restricted to authorized products (IDs 1 and 2), enforced via executor-bound views. The metric aggregates item counts using conditional sums for items with status 'Complete' and 'Returned'. No date filter was applied, encompassing all recorded history in the dataset.

| brand | complete_items | returned_items |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| North | 7 | 1 |
| South | 7 | 1 |

Both brand North and brand South recorded 7 Complete items and 1 Returned item each [q1].

### Limitations
- The query did not apply a date filter or return order timestamps, so item completion and return timing or historical trends were not measured [q1].
- Other item statuses (such as Shipped, Processing, or Cancelled) and distinct order or customer counts were not queried [q1].

### Action items (proposed)
- How do Complete and Returned item counts for these brands distribute by calendar year or month based on `order_items.created_at`?
- What are the Complete and Returned item volumes broken down by individual product ID or category within each brand?
